quote_zh: 向反应瓶中加入叔丁醇70mL，开动搅拌，室温下将14g氢氧化钠(30％，0.105mol)滴入其中，待氢氧化钠分散均匀后，控制釜温在30℃，将34.8g  2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(98％，0.1mol)倒入釜中进行碱解反应，反应过程微微放热，控制釜温为30℃，反应12h。反应结束，液相色谱中控2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐归一含量为92.5％，负压脱尽溶剂直接用于后续醚化反应。
arithmetic_check: Charges: sodium hydroxide 14 g of a 30% solution is 4.2 g of NaOH, which at 40.00 g/mol is 0.105 mol, exactly the printed figure. Substrate 34.8 g at 98% is 34.10 g, which at 341.60 g/mol for methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate (C10H10BrClO4S) is 0.0998 mol against the printed 0.1 mol. Both pairs close, so neither molar_mass_inconsistent nor mass_balance_implausible is raised. Product closure cannot be tested for this step and needs no flag: the salt is not isolated, no mass, mole figure or step yield is printed for it, and the only number given is the in-process HPLC content of 92.5%. Ratio, for the record, is 1.05 mol of base per mol of ester. Numbers recorded exactly as printed.

quote_zh: 向反应釜中加入160mLDMF、11.6g三氟乙醇(99％，0.115mol)和17.3g氢氧化钠溶液(30％，0.13mol)，开动搅拌，控制釜温在5℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(92.5％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为2h，加毕保温反应4h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至3，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物30.7g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为95.8％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率84.4％。
arithmetic_check: Charges: trifluoroethanol 11.6 g at 99% is 11.48 g, which at 100.04 g/mol (C2H3F3O) is 0.1148 mol against the printed 0.115 mol. Sodium hydroxide 17.3 g of a 30% solution is 5.19 g, which at 40.00 g/mol is 0.1298 mol against the printed 0.13 mol. The benzoate salt is charged as 0.1 mol at 92.5%, matching what step (1) produced, so there is no scale_discontinuity. Product closure: input 0.0998 mol of the methyl ester through step (1); product 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid is C11H10ClF3O5S, 346.70 g/mol; the printed 30.7 g at the printed 95.8% assay is 29.41 g of pure acid, which is 0.0848 mol, i.e. 85.0% of the 0.0998 mol charged, or 84.8% against a nominal 0.1 mol. The printed two-step yield is 84.4%. The gap is 0.4 to 0.6 of a percentage point, which is rounding and a slightly different molecular weight, so this CLOSES and no mass_balance_implausible or molar_mass_inconsistent is raised. Recorded here so A5 can re-derive it. Numbers recorded exactly as printed.
